title: The Asking to Redo a Crooked Label
youtube_title: The Asking to Redo a Crooked Label | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a small voice used at the right moment.
summary: At a small school room with a low stage edge, Ilaria feels shy about asking to peel a crooked label and try again. Instead of pretending not to care, Ilaria tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Mama stays kind and does not push for a show.
